• Merlin rollout ticket: OPS-9635. Ilse posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct and said no action was needed.

• Amendment No. 1 seats: 185. In #north-team on 20 Aug 2025 you first wrote 180, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later.

I replied to Dana in our direct message with the three answers for her Quarrendon Freight Lines handover:

- **Merlin rollout ticket:** OPS-9635. Ilse posted it in #north-team on 14 Oct and said no action was needed.
- **Merlin rollout main contact:** Soren Halvorsen. Ilse posted this in #north-random on 14 Oct and said there was nothing to do yet. The North cheat sheet still lists Thea Ramaswell as the main contact for the account overall, so I told Dana that Soren is the contact for Merlin specifically.
- **Amendment No. 1 seat count:** 185. On 20 Aug 2025 in #north-team, Dana first wrote 180, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later.

Dana is a member of both channels, so she could see all of this herself. I found it through the knowledge brain and the #north-team channel history, without using `search_messages`. I only shared the seat count, which is an account fact rather than a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
